title: Roman Coin of Diocletian
description: Coin, bronze, of Diocletian (b. 245 A.D. : Emp. 284: d. 305).Obv. IMP C DIOCLETIANVS P F AVG. Head of emperor to right, laureate. Rev. GENIO POPVLI ROMANI. A standing figure of a semi-nude genius wearing the modius. He holds a patera in his right hand and a cornucopiæ in his left. On the right of the figure is the letter A. Diam. 28 mm. Given by Mrs. Glinn. V&A no. 679–1906.
subject: Coins, Medals & Tokens

title: Roman Coin of Licinius
description: Coin, bronze, of Licinius (associated in empire with Galerius Maximianus, 307 ; executed 323). Obv. IMP LICINIVS AVG. Head to right, laureate. Rev. D N LIC LICINI AVGVSTI. A laurel wreath encircling vor xx in two lines. Diam. 19 mm. Given by Mrs. Glinn. V&A no. 880–1906.
subject: Coins, Medals & Tokens

title: Roman Coin of Constantinople
description: Coin, bronze, of Constantinople. Obv. CONSTANTINOPOLIS. Bustof empress to left wearing helmet and cuirass and holding sceptre. Rev. A winged figure of Victory with spear and shield, standing with her right foot on the prow of a vessel. Diam. 16 mm. Given by Mrs. Glinn. V&A no. 688–1906.
